criteria.description: The app SHALL present a landing view listing all 12 modules with title, one-line description, and current completion status.
criteria.evidence: WP02 review: set module statuses via the real API, header/landing re-rendered live with correct status; WP08 review: all 12 modules confirmed listed in order with real titles/summaries/statuses.

criteria.description: The app SHALL allow free navigation to any module from the landing view or a persistent nav menu, regardless of completion status.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review: hash routing verified between / and /module/:id with real anchor links; WP03 review: module<->landing navigation cycled repeatedly with no breakage; WP08 review: full click-through of all 12 modules.

criteria.description: Module 1 (Get Oriented) SHALL provide a labeled interface diagram, an external video/docs link, and a non-graded checklist.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: interface content matches diagram description; WP10 review: interface-map.svg renders correctly at desktop and 360px, wired and confirmed via live app render.

criteria.description: Module 2 SHALL present LLM-vs-Claude-Code content with a comparison table and a self-marked sort/match exercise.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: LLM/Claude Code comparison table and 6-item sort exercise verified live, correct-feedback confirmed.

criteria.description: Module 3 SHALL present data-safety content plus a spot-the-mistake exercise with at least one unsafe example.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: 6 chat snippets incl. 4 unsafe, all fake secrets confirmed unambiguously placeholder (no real-credential-format risk).

criteria.description: Module 3's exercise SHALL be graded, showing correct/incorrect per item, a score, and allowing retry.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: spot-mistake-lab.js scored correctly, retry allowed unlimited times, attempts persisted; WP07 review: live submission scored 6/6 against real Module 3 content.

criteria.description: Module 4 SHALL present repo/repo-folder content plus a self-marked folder-tree matching exercise.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: repo/folder content and match exercise verified; WP10 review: repo-folder-tree.svg descriptions matched verbatim to match-lab config, rendered correctly at both viewport sizes.

criteria.description: Module 5 SHALL explain MCP servers/config in plain language plus a self-marked scenario Q&A.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: MCP content and 4-scenario Q&A verified live, no undefined jargon found (NFR-003 spot check).

criteria.description: Module 6 SHALL present the role-context-task-format structure and the eight golden rules.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: role-context-task-format structure and all 8 golden rules present with a full worked weak-vs-strong example -- assessed as substantive teaching material, not filler.

criteria.description: Module 6 SHALL include an interactive prompt-builder lab that live-assembles a formatted prompt.
criteria.evidence: WP04 review: live preview updates synchronously on input, verified via direct browser interaction against the real mount() code path.

criteria.description: Every assembled/example prompt SHALL have a one-click copy-to-clipboard control.
criteria.evidence: WP04 review: real OS clipboard write confirmed, plus a verified manual-select fallback when clipboard access is unavailable; WP12 review: re-confirmed live with a real clipboard write.

criteria.description: The prompt-builder component SHALL be reusable across Modules 6, 8, 10, 11 with independent draft state.
criteria.evidence: WP04 review: two simulated instances (prompting-101 / prompting-201-rewrite) preserved independent drafts across mount/unmount; WP08 review: all 4 real purposeKeys (prompting-101, prompting-201-rewrite, automate-a-task, readme-exercise) verified non-colliding via live localStorage inspection.

criteria.description: Module 7 SHALL provide at least 3 downloadable mock-scenario .md files, each with its own download control.
criteria.evidence: WP09 review: 4 real, complete mock-scenario files verified (draft-a-client-email, summarize-a-meeting, plan-a-spreadsheet-cleanup, write-a-project-update); WP08 review: Module 7's download lab confirmed referencing the real filenames.

criteria.description: Module 8 SHALL present front-loading context, output-format requests, draft framing, explicit process commands, and thread/memory hygiene.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review: exact required phrase do-not-change-files-yet-propose-a-short-plan-and-wait-for-my-ok confirmed present verbatim; all 5 techniques covered.

criteria.description: Module 8 SHALL include a graded multiple-choice check plus a self-marked rewrite exercise using the shared builder.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: quiz-lab.js graded scoring/retry verified; WP08 review: 4-question quiz and prompting-201-rewrite builder both confirmed live.

criteria.description: Module 9 SHALL present a Claude Code vs. Gemini comparison plus a self-marked tool-choice mini-quiz.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review: Claude Code vs. Gemini comparison and 5-scenario tool-choice quiz verified live, no account required.

criteria.description: Module 10 SHALL walk through one worked automation example and include a lab to draft an automation prompt.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review: full worked automation example (messy list -> formatted table) with real prompt and response shown, plus automate-a-task builder lab verified.

criteria.description: Module 11 SHALL explain Markdown/why AI favors it and include a guided README-writing exercise.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review: Markdown/diffability content and readme-exercise builder (seeded with a concrete scenario) verified live.

criteria.description: Module 12 SHALL present a fixed graduation goal and exactly two downloads, with no worksheet/checklist/scripted prompts.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review (highest-stakes check of the mission): exactly 2 download entries confirmed matching docs/reference/gemini-agent-repo-blueprint.md and example-agent-minutes-milo.md verbatim, no worksheet/checklist/scripted prompt found -- clean C-007 pass; WP12 review: re-confirmed live.

criteria.description: The app SHALL automatically persist progress with no manual save action, and SHALL show a brief saved indicator after each write.
criteria.evidence: Autosave mechanism verified across every WP review (debounced write, corrupt-data fallback, reload persistence). The visible saved indicator sub-requirement was found missing during the acceptance pass (2026-09-03) and fixed in commit 2b9add6 on lane-l; verified live via DOM inspection: hidden -> visible (Saved) ~700ms after a real write (past the 400ms debounce) -> hidden again ~2.3s later (past the 1.5s auto-hide).

criteria.description: The landing view SHALL display an overall course-completion indicator.
criteria.evidence: WP02 review: overall completion string (X of 12 modules complete) confirmed updating live in the header as progress changed.

criteria.description: The app SHALL provide a confirmation-gated reset-my-progress control.
criteria.evidence: WP02 review: reset buttons cancel path (data untouched) and confirm path (localStorage cleared, view returns to first-visit state) both verified live.

criteria.description: The app SHALL present a persistent header with course name, current module, progress indicator, and a home control.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review: persistent header (course title, current module label, home link, progress placeholder) confirmed present on every route, real anchor/nav elements.

criteria.description: Every lab screen SHALL provide a clear, always-visible exit control -- no dead-end screens.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: back-to-all-modules link confirmed present on every module route, independent of the mounted lab; WP05/WP06 review: each lab engines own exit affordance confirmed present.

criteria.description: Content pages longer than one viewport SHALL provide a scroll-to-top control.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review: scroll-to-top control confirmed hidden by default, appearing after ~1 viewport of scroll, smooth-scrolling to top on click.

criteria.description: The app SHALL be fully navigable via keyboard and mouse/touch, with no tool installation beyond a browser.
criteria.evidence: WP01 review: keyboard Tab produced a visible focus ring on interactive elements; native anchor/button elements confirmed throughout (Enter/Space activation by construction); WP12 review: full-app spot check found no keyboard traps.

criteria.description: The app SHALL be installable as a Progressive Web App.
criteria.evidence: WP11 review: manifest.json confirmed valid, sensible name/start_url/display/icons; link rel=manifest resolved with no console warning.

criteria.description: The app SHALL function fully offline after first load, except Module 1's external video link.
criteria.evidence: WP11 review: genuine stopped-server offline test -- service worker reached activated, 39-entry precache confirmed complete against the real file tree, app shell + module routes + both Module 12 downloads all served correctly with the origin server fully stopped. WP12 review: independently re-verified via preview_start with the same stopped-server method, superseding an earlier code-review-only fallback with an actual passing live test.
